opportunities.name: Mist-fed healer cadence
opportunities.objective: Test whether attacks reduce Q cooldown enough to deliver repeated ally heals and buffs.
opportunities.mechanic: Q heals with 0.35 AP and 0.4 AD[statFormula=2] and attacks reduce its cooldown by one second. Mist adds finite AD; Nashor and Ardent support real attack cadence while Helia can consume prior damage charges on Q healing. Staff supplies a caster ally buff and haste for the next Q.
opportunities.requiredState: Finite Mist stacks; safe attacks and an ally lie on the Q line.
opportunities.failure: Senna long attack windups or unsafe targeting defeat the cooldown gain.
opportunities.test: Measure Q interval, attacks completed and ally healing/buff uptime at fixed Mist.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Attack speed does not remove Senna special attack windup or make all Q hits ordinary attacks.

opportunities.name: AP mist procession
opportunities.objective: Use AP for team movement and large shields while retaining ranged attack follow-up.
opportunities.mechanic: E wraith speed has 0.0005 AP, R shield 0.5 AP plus finite Mist, and Q slow 0.0007 AP. Shurelya helps the team move through E while Lich Bane supports a real follow-up attack. Cryptbloom offers a conditional takedown heal; R remains physical despite its AP damage ratio.
opportunities.requiredState: Allies need E escape/approach and line up for R shielding; use finite Mist.
opportunities.failure: The expensive AP route loses attack damage and may shield allies after the threat has ended.
opportunities.test: Log E movement, R shielding and one attack packet; record physical R damage separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP scaling does not convert R physical damage to magic or make magic penetration improve it.

ruledOut.reason: Absolution explicitly adjusts Senna crit damage and excess crit becomes lifesteal; normal carry crit assumptions are unsupported.

unknowns: Q on-hit/item delivery and Mist siphon triggers need packet checks; AP route is a farmed-income gamble with quest retained.

builds.name: Mist-fed healer cadence
builds.summary: Test whether attacks reduce Q cooldown enough to deliver repeated ally heals and buffs.
builds.goal: Test whether attacks reduce Q cooldown enough to deliver repeated ally heals and buffs.
builds.hypothesis: Q heals with 0.35 AP and 0.4 AD[statFormula=2] and attacks reduce its cooldown by one second. Mist adds finite AD; Nashor and Ardent support real attack cadence while Helia can consume prior damage charges on Q healing. Staff supplies a caster ally buff and haste for the next Q.
testPlan: Required state: Finite Mist stacks; safe attacks and an ally lie on the Q line.
Measure Q interval, attacks completed and ally healing/buff uptime at fixed Mist.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Senna long attack windups or unsafe targeting defeat the cooldown gain.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Attack speed does not remove Senna special attack windup or make all Q hits ordinary attacks.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Celestial Opposition, Nashor's Tooth, Echoes of Helia, Ardent Censer, Staff of Flowing Water, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Senna's Attacks take extra time to fire, deal an additional [(0.2) × AD] physical damage, and briefly grant her [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.1, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05000000074505806, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05000000074505806, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] of the target's Move Speed.
